detectionOnly: Detection and reporting only. Nothing in bespoke-ruleset-catalogue.md or any other doc under docs/hunter-playbooks/ was read from or written to by this sweep — every hit below comes from the source PDF. Yoshi adjudicates each one.

coverage.method: Every page scanned in full. Columns detected per page from the line-start x histogram (110pt gap threshold against a ~248pt column pitch). Within each column, the same body/option state machine extract-moves.mjs uses (imported from lib-move-body.mjs, not reimplemented) runs over both the bulleted segments and the pre-first-bullet prose region. Hits are attributed to the nearest standalone bold heading above them, with spill-over from a preceding column on the same page when a column has no heading of its own.
